Lina H: Heads-up  Partner rebate received today for annual prepaid contract INV-2024-0780. Credit amount $36,000. Need direction: reduce deferred revenue schedule or post as contra-rev? Close next Wed.
Carlos P: Can you confirm original invoice amount, service period, and vendor note wording?
Lina H: Original invoice $360,000 for 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30. Vendor note says: "rebate applied for billing reconciliation on INV-2024-0780."
Elliot (Accounting): Language suggests an adjustment to the contract value. If rebate corrects prior overcharge, it is a prior-period correction for recognized revenue portion. If it's a negotiated rebate for future service, treat prospectively.
Carlos P: How many months recognized so far?
Lina H: Recognized through 2024-09 (3 months). Original monthly amort = 30,000.
Elliot (Accounting): Quick calc: 36k is 10% of contract. Recognized portion = 3 * 30k * 10% = 9,000; remaining 27,000 affects deferred balance.
Nina Controller: Upload vendor communication and confirm whether partner will reissue a corrected invoice or this is a one-time rebate. Audit will want evidence.
Lina H: Uploaded PDF and email from partner into this thread. Email explicitly: "rebate for overbilling on INV-2024-0780".
Elliot (Accounting): Given that wording, treat as prior-period error. Prepare restatement memo and impact schedule. Do not post corrective revenue-reducing JE without Controller + CFO sign-off.
Carlos P: For month close, recommendation: park the full rebate in a suspense/liability account to avoid incorrect timing. Proposed interim JE:
```
DR 2400 Deferred Revenue   36,000
CR 9999 Suspense Clearing 36,000
```
This removes the rebate from deferred until approval.
Nina Controller: Agree with suspense approach. Ben in FP&A should prepare the P&L by month impact and a short memo for CFO. Also flag tax team.
Lina H: Noted. I'll ask FP&A and tax. What's the turnaround for CFO sign-off? Close is Wed EOD.
Elliot (Accounting): We'll queue the restatement memo today; if CFO cannot sign before close, keep suspense entry and schedule final posting early next period with full sign-off.
revbot: Reminder: month-end cutoff 2024-09-30 17:00 UTC. All JEs after cutoff require CFO rationale tag.
Lina H: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Carlos P: Thanks, will follow up after memo is posted.
